README: rev1186c exact certificates. Units: positions in 1/1096; values are TRUE units (not scaled). Grid cells I_i=[pts[i],pts[i+1]]/1096. Slab certificate: for y in [0,1]^n with lo<=m<=hi (m=sum w_i y_i, w_i=(pts[i+1]-pts[i])/1096): L_theta(y) - B = v'Sv + sum_f mu_f f(y), v=(1,y), S PD, mu>=0, f>=0 on the domain, L_theta<=L. Form keys: ('lin','y',i)=y_i; ('lin','1-y',i)=1-y_i; ('lin','m-lo')=m-lo; ('lin','hi-m')=hi-m; ('mhm',)=(m-lo)(hi-m); ('ym-lo',i)=y_i(m-lo); ('om-lo',i)=(1-y_i)(m-lo); ('yhi-m',i)=y_i(hi-m); ('ohi-m',i)=(1-y_i)(hi-m); ('yy',i,j)=y_i y_j; ('oo',i,j)=(1-y_i)(1-y_j); ('yo',i,j)=y_i(1-y_j); ('tri',i,j,k,s1,s2,s3)=1+s1 z_i z_j + s2 z_j z_k + s3 z_i z_k, z=1-2y. theta[c] indexes the cut pairs in the order of cells.get(grid)['cut'] as listed in the field cuts: [i, j, s_i*s_j, A_in, A_out] (ordered pair, a in I_i, b in I_j; full pairs are not listed). With P=w_i w_j y_i y_j: s_i s_j=+1: L contains (1-theta)(P-A_out); s_i s_j=-1: L contains theta(-A_in)+(1-theta)(-P). Rest of L: sum_i (a_i y_i + b_i y_i^2) [a_i,b_i: see model.py/cells.py] + sum over full pairs s_i s_j w_i w_j y_i y_j. S is NOT stored; rebuild it from L_theta - B - sum mu f.
